purpose: Classify who supplies stock, whether visible institutions absorb it, where TDCC ownership migrates, and whether ownership rotation strengthens or reverses. No continuous score is authorized.

data_contract.three_leg_source: HENGCE original vessel / canonical Historical Mother semantics
data_contract.tdcc_source: existing HENGCE official TDCC targeted historical vessel/parser

derived_ownership.warning: TDCC bucket changes are ownership-threshold migration, not accounting purchase flow.

interval_selection.snapshots: latest three PIT-proxy-eligible weekly snapshots A < B < C before/on event eligibility cutoff

funding_flow.margin_market_net_shares: SUM((MarginBuy - MarginSell) * 1000) over current TDCC interval trading days
funding_flow.margin_cash_repayment_shares: SUM(MarginCashRepayment * 1000) over current TDCC interval trading days
funding_flow.t86_total_net_shares: SUM(TotalNet) over current TDCC interval trading days
funding_flow.visible_receiver_diagnostic: compare ForeignNet, TrustNet and dealer proxy/DealerNet without treating any TDCC bucket as identical to a T86 identity

predeclared_fingerprints.definition: weak_or_absorbed AND margin_market_supply AND t86_visible_absorption AND current_topology == FRESH_MID_BROADENING
weak_or_absorbed AND margin_market_supply AND t86_visible_absorption AND current dMid400to1000Shares > 0 AND current dMid400to1000Holders == 0
weak_or_absorbed AND margin_market_net_shares <= 0 AND t86_no_visible_absorption AND current_topology == FRESH_MID_BROADENING AND current dMid400to1000Holders > 0
weak_or_absorbed AND margin_market_supply AND t86_visible_absorption AND current_topology == WHALE_CONCENTRATION

validation_policy.event_universe: Frozen Monster BUY V1 events only; T4 never creates or deletes Monster signals during this test.
validation_policy.small_sample_rule: Report as research candidate only; do not freeze a fingerprint from tiny n.
